info.name: Turf Backend API - Complete
info.description: Complete Postman collection based on the project Express routes. Follow Public Catalog, User Journey, Business Journey, and Admin Journey in order. Configure baseUrl, credentials and dynamic Mongo IDs. Admin registration is gated by ADMIN_REGISTRATION_KEY. Routes also mounted at legacy aliases are noted in request descriptions. Explicit requests for every auth and booking alias are included in the final folder. The default baseUrl is http://localhost:5000, matching the server default; change it if your local deployment uses another port.

item.name: 00 - Health and Public Catalog
item.description: Start with health checks and browse the public catalog: sports, turfs, venues, availability, plans and reviews.

item.name: 01 - User Journey
item.description: Order: signup/login (saves userToken), browse availability, book, pay if needed, then manage account. Booking endpoints are also mounted at /api/user/bookings.

exec: try { const d = pm.response.json(); const n = d.data || d.result || {}; const t = d.token || d.accessToken || n.token || n.accessToken; if (t) { pm.collectionVariables.set('userToken', t); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set('userToken', t); } const r = d.refreshToken || n.refreshToken; if (r) { pm.collectionVariables.set('userRefreshToken', r); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set('userRefreshToken', r); } } catch (e) { console.log('No JSON token response to capture'); }
